title: CI/CD Generator IR (pipeline.yaml)
description: Vendor-neutral Intermediate Representation for the agentic, platform-agnostic CI/CD generator. Names a ci_vendor and a target_platform independently; any valid combination is generatable. Unknown fields are rejected to enable fail-fast validation downstream (R1, R2, R3.1).

version.description: IR schema version. Currently only version 1 is supported.

ci_vendor.description: Where the pipeline runs (CI-vendor axis, R3). Pluggable; enum reflects the v1 mapping table (design 8a).

target_platform.description: What gets built and deployed (target-platform axis, R3). Pluggable; enum reflects the v1 mapping table (design 8b). Independent of ci_vendor.

language.description: Primary language of the project (e.g. python, node, java). Optional; agent may infer during discovery.

cloud.description: Cloud context, driven by target_platform. Optional; a documented default applies when omitted (R2.2).

auth.description: Authentication mode. OIDC is preferred; keys are discouraged.

environments.description: Deployment environments and their gate/protection rules (R2). Order is not significant; stages reference environments by name.

name.description: Environment name (e.g. dev, staging, prod). Referenced by stages.environment.

gate.description: Whether promotion into this environment is automatic or requires a manual gate.

protection.description: Branch/environment protection applied to this environment.

stages.description: Ordered pipeline stages (R1/R2). Array order defines pipeline order. At least one stage is required.

id.description: Unique stage identifier (e.g. test, security, build, deploy-prod).

enabled.description: Whether this stage is emitted/run. Documented default: true (R2.2).

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum wall-clock minutes for the stage before it is cancelled.

retries.description: Number of automatic retries on failure. Default: 0.

runs.description: Command the stage runs (e.g. 'make test'). Orchestration only; platform verbs supply the implementation (R4).

scans.description: Security scans to run in this stage. Any subset of the supported scan types (R2.1).

environment.description: Name of the environment this stage targets. Must match an entry under 'environments' (enforced by the validator, not the schema).

when.description: Trigger mode for the stage. 'manual' requires an operator to proceed.

depends_on.description: Ids of stages that must run before this stage (design 11.3). Optional; when omitted/empty the declared array order remains the execution order (backward compatible). Each id must name a declared stage and the dependency graph must be acyclic (enforced by the core's stage-graph validator, not the schema).

approvals.description: Approval requirements before the stage proceeds (R2.1).

from_group.description: Reviewer group name; resolved from local config (.cicd/*.local.yaml), never inlined.

thresholds.description: Quality/performance gates (R2.1). Optional; documented defaults apply when omitted.

coverage_min_percent.description: Minimum test-coverage percentage required to pass.

max_build_minutes.description: Maximum allowed build time in minutes.

promotion.description: Build-once / promote-across-environments configuration (design 11.6). Optional; when omitted behaviour is unchanged (backward compatible). When enabled, one build+package pair produces an immutable artifact reference and each environment in 'path' runs only deploy+verify consuming the SAME reference; the chosen target_platform plugin must declare the artifact_promotion capability (enforced by the core's capability gate, not the schema). Every name in 'path' must be a declared environment (enforced by the validator, not the schema).

enabled.description: Whether promotion is active. Documented default: true (R2.2).

artifact.description: Logical name of the promotable artifact (e.g. service-image). The reference itself (image digest / versioned object key) is resolved by-reference at package time; no value is inlined (R6).

path.description: Environments to promote through, in order. Either a list of declared environment names (e.g. ["dev", "staging", "prod"]) OR a 'dev -> staging -> prod' arrow string (normalised to a list by the validator). At least one environment is required.
